title: Mahlangu Evidence & Evaluation consultancy launch

job.buyer: Founder of a South African monitoring, evaluation and research consultancy
job.request: Turn the supplied founder notes, service list and project evidence into a production-ready professional website package.

case_context.buyer_problem: Programme leaders have evidence spread across surveys, interviews and reports but still need a clear basis for decisions.
case_context.desired_outcome: A credible public presence that explains the consultancy's services and makes it easy for NGOs, universities and public-sector programmes to enquire.

source_documents.text:
CLIENT BRIEF
Business name: Mahlangu Evidence & Evaluation
Founder: Dr Naledi Mahlangu
Founder experience: 12 years in programme evaluation, survey design and applied research.
Positioning note: "We make data useful."
Preferred tone: credible, practical, warm, not corporate.
Geographic reach: South Africa, with remote work available nationally.
Target buyers: NGOs; universities; public-sector programmes; development agencies.
Contact email: hello@mahlanguevaluation.example

CURRENT SERVICE LIST
- Programme evaluation
- Survey design and analysis
- Qualitative research
- Evidence synthesis
- Research reports and decision briefs

ANONYMISED PROJECT NOTES
Project A: Mixed-method evaluation of a provincial youth employment programme. Work included survey design, interview analysis and a decision brief.
Project B: Evidence synthesis for a university community-engagement initiative. Work included document review and stakeholder interviews.
No client names may be disclosed.
No client testimonials have been supplied.
No awards or certifications have been supplied.

constraints: Do not fabricate clients, testimonials, awards, certifications or success percentages.
Preserve client anonymity in project examples.
The website may prepare an enquiry but may not send it or take payment.
